_meta.coder_notes: CIK CORRECTION: The batch file lists SoundThinking/ShotSpotter as CIK 1476470, which is WRONG. CIK 1476470 = 'CARBON 612 Corp', a revoked shell (SIC Measuring & Controlling Devices), last filing 2014. The correct CIK for SoundThinking, Inc. (f/k/a SHOTSPOTTER, INC) is 1351636 (ticker SSTI), confirmed via EDGAR full-text search display_names and data.sec.gov submissions (former name SHOTSPOTTER, INC 2015-2023). All ShotSpotter coding below uses CIK 1351636. McDonald's (63908), UnitedHealth (731766), and Uber (1543151) CIKs were verified correct via efts display_names.
_meta.method: EDGAR full-text search (efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index) restricted per correct CIK for specific-incident terms and same-family risk vocabulary; confirmed by opening in-window 10-K Risk Factors / Legal Proceedings where doc size permitted. Note: efts /search-index returns no highlight field, so presence/absence + year enumeration was used, supplemented by direct filing reads for SoundThinking FY2021/FY2023 and UnitedHealth FY2023. Session WebFetch limit was reached before direct reads of a McDonald's and a Uber 10-K could confirm exact risk-factor wording; those two companies' codes rely on efts presence/absence evidence plus one confirmed cross-company AI/ML risk-factor pattern.
_meta.no_T1_or_T2: No incident was specifically disclosed (T1) and none had its specific legal/regulatory proceeding disclosed in filings (T2). Every matched specific-incident term (Durham, biometric, McHire, nH Predict, naviHealth-in-risk-context, facial recognition) returned zero relevant hits. accounting_channel is null for all (only T1/T2 carry a channel).

255.evidence: Correct issuer CIK 1351636 (SoundThinking f/k/a ShotSpotter).
